== Biography ==
Alexander Glasgow, born in 1837, was baptized on October 22, 1837, in Rutherglen, Lanarkshire, Scotland. His parents were Ralph Glasgow and Ann McLean. The baptism took place within the context of the Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564-1929 collection, classified under the Birth, Marriage, Death & Parish Records category, specifically within the subcategory of Parish Baptisms. The record provides valuable information about Alexander's birth and baptism, along with details about his parents and their residence in Rutherglen, Lanarkshire. This entry contributes to the broader collections from Great Britain, Scotland, focusing on birth and baptismal events within the context of parish records.

In the 1851 England, Wales & Scotland Census, a 13-year-old named Alexander Glasgow is listed as the son in the household. Born in 1838 in Glasgow, Lanarkshire, Scotland, he worked as an errand boy. The family resided at 30 Old Dalmarnock Road, Calton, Bridgeton, Lanarkshire. The census record falls under the Census, land & surveys category and is part of the collections from Great Britain, Scotland. It offers insights into Alexander's age, birthplace, occupation, and family residence during the 1851 census.
